description: Ohtsuki kappa-series for 6_1 from the ki6c eq.(29) Kashaev triple sum, evaluated in O(N^2) by a two-convolution factorisation of the i<=j<=k chain (verified against the literal triple sum). Fits log<6_1>_N - (3/2)log N in {N, 1, 1/N, ...}; the 1/N^i coefficients are the log-series lambda_i, converted to kappa_i by the standard recurrence. VALIDATION GATE: fitted sigma and omega must reproduce ki6c's printed 6-digit values (up to conjugation, DETECTED not assumed) or no kappa is reported. Branch unwrapping is guided by the paper's sigma to pick the 2*pi*m integer only; disclosed in the docstring. A kappa-series is the perturbative input to a Borel/Stokes extraction, NOT itself a DT count. Scope-(a); nothing wired. Beans qou-6ort/qou-btvl.

diagnosis.reading: moduli confirmed to 4 digits by an independent route, so the residual freedom is PHASES; most likely a dropped or misread index-dependent q-power in the OCR of the simplification to eq.(29) form 3
diagnosis.not_tuned: no formula variant was searched for one hitting the target; that would be fitting a transcription to it

scope.not_a_dt_count: kappa_i are perturbative coefficients of the asymptotic expansion; the DT/Stokes constants require a Borel resummation this probe does not do
scope.branch_guide: ki6c's 6-digit sigma selects the 2*pi*m branch integer only; it is not an input to the fitted value
scope.form3_vs_form4_not_independent: form 4 is derived here from form 3 by the stated substitution, so that check is algebra, not transcription; the independent check is form 2

gate_outcome.why_recorded_not_asserted: the gate failing is the finding; the asserted controls are what make it trustworthy
